key_insight: CurvDelta restricts model updates to a low-curvature space to acquire or remove targeted capabilities while better preserving general capabilities.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a geometry-aware approach to LLM fine-tuning and selective unlearning when retaining existing capabilities is critical.
method: Analyze local preservation-loss geometry around the pre-adaptation model to identify low-curvature update directions.
Use Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and factorized projection to make the construction practical for LLMs.
Introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank adaptation variant using the same preservation geometry.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive math and code performance with better general-capability retention, plus improved forgetting–retention balance on TOFU and MUSE, with retention close to from-scratch retraining.
watch_item: Preservation relies on a local, approximate curvature model; robustness to large updates and curvature-estimation overhead should be checked in deployment.
paper_title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
